_method: Fuls method B (subsets of zones sharing one stamp), synodic month p = 29.53 d, tolerance per Fuls Table 8.1; chance baseline w = 2*t_p/p (formula 8.7)
_meaning: hit_pct is the share of the hat's zone-group combinations that land on an integer multiple of the synodic month; chance_pct is the rate a random sum would hit. Selective == clearly above chance.
_caveat: Only Schifferstadt is selective, and its corroboration is metrological (Kalotte:shaft 3:9), not the Berlin rule. Berlin's reading does not transfer to the other hats.
